protocol.purpose: Independent read-only semantic adjudication of the frozen 50; no pool, fixture, gold, scoring boundaries or engine changes.
protocol.evidence: All 50 expected entries, actual structured claims, English semantic-review templates, rendered locale text/detail/items inspected; source-bundle facts and canonical year counts checked.
protocol.targetedResponseDefinition: Addresses the actual requested information or missing ambiguity, even if only partially; topical overlap or a truthful statement about a different quantity does not suffice.
protocol.fullSuccessBoundary: A full answer must supply requested supported facts or substantive corrective explanation. Relevant partial explanation is recorded separately without upgrading to full success. Clarification is useful when it identifies the actual missing referent/filter.
protocol.languageLimit: Hausa meanings were compared to the supplied English templates and draft questions. This is not fluent-human Hausa sign-off.
protocol.independenceLimit: Reviewer authored the gold pool independently of implementation, then saw frozen outputs. This is independent of implementation, not a second independent gold author.
